title: Large robotic fish-like device on pool deck with 'BREED HKU' marking
objects_and_counts: One large fish-shaped robotic device or hull assembly is visible lying on its side on the pool deck near the pool edge; the device occupies most of the image foreground and appears to be a single assembly.
One human arm and hand are visible at the top-right of the image, with the hand grasping the robot's tail; the arm/hand is cropped at the image edge.
One black mounting or bracket piece is visible attached to the underside of the device near its midsection.
One pair of articulated tail fins (two fin halves) is visible at the right end of the device; the fins are attached and splashing water into the pool.
One orange lifebuoy is visible hanging on the right-side railing in the background.
One orange starting block or seat-shaped object is visible at the far left edge of the image (partially visible and cropped).
A row of small triangular pennant flags is visible across the top of the image; nine pennants are individually visible.
Multiple small blue floating lane markers are visible in the pool at the right side; at least six individual blue floats can be counted along the lane rope.
Spectator seating (concrete or tiled stepped bleachers) is visible along the left side of the scene; the stepped seating is a continuous structure rather than discrete counted items.
spatial_relations: The robotic device lies on its side on the tiled pool deck, oriented roughly left-to-right across the image with its nose at the left and tail at the right.
The device's tail extends over the pool edge and the tail fins are above the pool water at the right side; the hand is holding the tail from above and slightly behind the fins.
The black mounting/bracket piece is attached beneath the device near the mid-to-rear section and sits between the device body and the tiled deck.
Concrete or tiled stepped spectator seating runs along the left side of the image behind the deck, parallel to the pool.
A row of triangular pennants hangs across the top of the image, spanning from left to right above the pool and device.
The pool lanes run from foreground to background on the right side of the image; lane ropes and blue lane floats lie on the water surface parallel to the pool edge.
colours_and_materials: The robotic device hull appears off-white to pale beige and looks like a smooth, possibly plastic or composite surface with visible water droplets.
A black mounting/bracket is attached to the bottom/midsection of the device; the bracket has a matte finish.
The pool water is blue and reflective; lane ropes have yellow and blue colors visible in the right background.
The tiled pool deck is light beige with a textured, grid-like tile pattern.
Triangular pennant flags are multicolored (visible blue, green, red, yellow) and are suspended above the pool on a string.
Bleacher steps at left are pale stone or concrete in a light cream color; railings in the background appear dark green or black metal.
uncertainties: Location is not indicated by any visible room name or number in the image; therefore the location is unknown from the image.
The small printed tag or sign floating near the tail splash in the pool is present but its text is not legible from this view.
The visible 'NO' text on the device is legible but context or complete label is not shown; it is located near the black bracket on the device's side.
Some objects are partially cropped (the human arm/hand at top-right and the orange object at the far left) so their full extent cannot be determined.
Exact identification of the device material (plastic, composite, or other) is uncertain and reported here as a visual appearance only.
Counts of lane marker floats and pennants are based on individually distinguishable elements visible in this frame; additional similar elements may exist outside the image.
